'''Domain Val''' was a [[Domain]] among the [[Warrior caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Notable members of the Domain included [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ekh'm Val]], who rediscovered [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]], and [[Krag Val]].
